title: Ireland – Recruitment services – Provision of Sourcing of Short-term and Temporary Locum General Practitioners (GPs) for the Health Sector in Ireland.
description: The Health Service Executive seeks to appoint suitably qualified employment agencies to source short-term locum General Practitioners (GPs) for General Medical Services (GMS) GPs working in rural Ireland. The purpose of this tender is to support access to locum cover for up to 250 GMS General Practitioners (GPs) in rural and remote areas, who are in receipt of the Rural Practice allowance. GPs in rural and remote areas must be able to access reliable locum cover to allow them take leave knowing that their patients will continue to receive high-quality care in their absence. This scheme, developed under the terms of the 2023 GP Agreement, addresses a critical need for rural GPs who often face significant challenges in securing cover for periods of planned leave. It is envisaged that most leave requests will be for 1 to 2 week leave periods. The maximum leave duration that will be requested is a block of 5 weeks in total. Under this scheme, eligible GPs in receipt of rural practice support will have access to a streamlined locum sourcing service. The service is currently provided by one employment agency under a non-compliant pilot programme set up by the National Contracts Office. This tender process is being conducted as an open-style tender under Annex XIV of Procurement directives 2014/24/EU. The required services are listed as Annex XIV services, and accordingly, only Articles 74 to 77 of Directive 2014/24/EC applies to the award of any contract(s) that arise from this process. As such, there is considerable flexibility in conducting the tender process and this is required given the specialist nature of the services required and the very limited market. Tenderers will be ranked and scored according to the Award Criteria stated. The four top ranked tenderers will be offered a contract. The estimated cost is €100k + VAT per year. The contract is for an initial 36-month period. At the end of this period the HSE can assess if the services being delivered are satisfactory or if the requirements of the scheme changes. There are 2 x 12-month optional extensions. The current focus is ensuring that a contract is in place in early 2027

title: Finland – Food, beverages, tobacco and related products – Elintarvikehankintojen dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä
description: Tällä ilmoituksella HUS-yhtymä perustaa dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (jäljempänä DPS) elintarvikkeiden hankkimiseen. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin osallistumispyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Hankittavat tuotteet määritellään tarkemmin kussakin dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisessä kilpailutuksessa. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on voimassa 31.12.2035 saakka, ellei sitä erillisellä ilmoituksella lyhennetä tai pidennetä. HUS arvioi osallistumispyynnön julkaisuhetkellä, että dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisällä julkaistaan vuosien 2025-2035 aikana 5 - 15 kilpailutusta. Määrä on alustava arvio, joka voi muuttua merkittävästikin kun kilpailutustarve ja tuotteiden ryhmittely selkeytyy. HUS arvioi osallistumispyynnön julkaisuhetkellä dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän koko keston kokonaisarvoksi enintään 16 000 000 - 19 000 000 euroa huomioiden kaikki järjestelmässä mahdollisesti tehdyt hankinnat. Arvio on alustava ja perustuu tällä hetkellä tiedossa olevaan hankintatarpeeseen. HUS ei sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin tai määräostovelvoitteisiin tällä ilmoituksella. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. Se on voimassa hankintailmoituksessa ilmoitettuun päivään asti, ellei sitä keskeytetä tai muuteta dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän voimassa ollessa. Varsinaiset hankinnat tehdään dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, joissa kuvataan ja täsmennetään hankinnan kohde. Jokaisesta sisäisestä kilpailutuksesta solmitaan erillinen sopimus. Sopimuskausi määritellään sisäisessä kilpailutuksessa erikseen tapauskohtaisesti. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voi hakea tarjoajaksi, ja siihen otetaan mukaan kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät ehdokkaat.

title: Dachsanierung/ -erweiterung Gebäude 102 - Objektplanung
description: Das Deutsche Zentrum für Luft- und Raumfahrt e.V. (DLR) ist das Forschungszentrum der Bundesrepublik Deutschland für Luft- und Raumfahrt. Seine umfangreichen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsarbeiten in Luftfahrt, Raumfahrt, Energie, Verkehr, Sicherheit und Digitalisierung sind in nationale und internationale Kooperationen eingebunden. Die Deutsche Raumfahrtagentur im DLR ist im Auftrag der Bundesregierung für die Planung und Umsetzung der deutschen Raumfahrtaktivitäten zuständig. Zwei DLR-Projektträger betreuen Förderprogramme und unterstützen den Wissenstransfer. Zu den Forschungsschwerpunkten am Standort Bremen gehören Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie die maritime Sicherheit. Der Standort Bremen unterstützt die Innovationskraft der Region. Das erste DLR-Institut am Standort wurde 2007 gegründet. Seitdem baut das DLR seine Forschungsthemen in Bremen kontinuierlich aus und ist seit 2019 auch mit dem Virtual Produkt House im Innovationszentrum ECOMAT vertreten. Das Dach des Laborgebäudes 102 in der Robert-Hooke-Straße 7b in Bremen befindet sich in einem sanierungsbedürftigen Zustand. Im Rahmen der gegenständlichen Maßnahme ist eine umfassende Grundsanierung vorgesehen, welche die vollständige Entfernung und Erneuerung der bestehenden Dachabdichtung einschließlich Wärmedämmung und Dampfsperre umfasst. Gegenstand dieser Vergabe sind die dafür erforderlichen Objektplanungsleistungen Gebäude gem. §§ 33 ff HOAI in den Leistungsphasen 2 - 3 und 5 - 9.

title: TERABIT PER SECOND ETHERNET SWITCH FOR CONSTELLATIONS WITH OPTICAL INTERSATELLITE LINKS (ARTES 4.0 SL SPL 5F.046)
description: The objective of the activity is to develop, manufacture and test a technology agnostic ethernet switch intellectual property (IP) core supporting layers 1 to 3 as needed for constellations with optical intersatellite links. The core will be implemented and tested on a field programmable gate array. The data rate and number of ports shall be configurable, and multi-protocol label switching, Flex Ethernet and internet protocol shall be supported. Targeted Improvements: Enabling a European or Canadian source of space compatible ethernet switches for low earth orbit constellations.Description: Cost sensitive low earth orbit constellation solutions require a tailored packet switch adapted to the need with respect to data rate above 10 Gbps, number of ports (16 and more) and supportedprotocols. A technology agnostic ethernet switch, scalable in data rate and number of ports and supporting layer 1 to 3 protocols, does not exist in the space industry. Commercial solutions are available as black box solutions that cannot be modified. They provide much more functionality, which makes them unattractive for the cost sensitive application case in low earth orbit constellations. Commercial solutions of much more capable switches are available but cannot be adapted to the application need. Flex Ethernet, multi-protocol label switching, and internet protocol are currently discussed but suitable solutions could not be found in ongoing technology studies. The activity will develop a technology agnostic ethernet switch that can be implemented in different hardware solutions. A representative breadboard will be developed, manufactured and tested. The main engineering tasks are the development of the switch IP core in line with the requirements for the low Eorbit constellation application, testing of the IP core on at least two selected technologies and testing of the IP core implemented in a breadboard.

title: CSG’s Digitalization - Information Broadcast topic
description:
In the context of CSG’s Digitalization process whose goal is to :
•	Reduce re configuration delay in between two launches
•	Maintenance and Operation reduction costs
•	Turn the CSG into an attractive spot for new space operators
•	Improve space base availability
•	Daily life improvement and simplification
The CSG will capitalize on the basis that was set by the ‘Socle Numérique Transverse (SNT)’ project in order to bring a brand new Information System.
The global scope that the digitalization services must address are:
•	Satellites’ and launch campaigns operations
•	Maintenance and sustainability (in line with the SNT project)
•	CSG’s space base Infrastructures (physical, software or virtual) (mainly for networks and informatics)
•	Security, Safety and protection 
•	Daily life improvement and simplification
•	Communication
•	Datacenters
•	Projects valorization and marketability
•	Process improvements and optimization
•	Radars and Simulations
In order to match those needs, the project teams will be organized according to the following topics:
•	IT Networks
•	Planification and Task/Operation management
•	Maintenance management
•	Technical fact management
•	Data management
•	IT Hardware
•	Right profile and access management
•	Safety and Security
•	Information Broadcast
•	Radar and Launcher Simulation
Two transversal teams will be in charge of the global consistency of the projects for planning and architectural/urbanization purposes
 This publication concerns the Information Broadcast topic
The expected services provision for each of those items are:
•	Architecture and urbanization of the systems, taken into account Maintenance and optimizations 
•	Project Management officer. Projects will have to be managed through a project’s portfolio. Team guidance for steps definition and planning formalization, accurate indicators follow up.
•	Requirements analysis and formalization of the projects that will be designed to meet those requirements.
•	Project owner support for specification redaction for each identified project, document redaction and accurate technical descriptions 
•	Market surveys and state of art
•	Analysis reports of studied solutions
•	Proof of concept based on the solution identified and validation
•	Project management for design, development, implementation and deployment of the identified projects
•	Providing the solutions and implements them (could be external solutions of specialized editors and vendors)
•	Support and coaching for information security analysis 
•	On-site installation (when necessary) and global system technical validation. The holder of the contract will be responsible of the supplies that will be plugged with CNES CSG’s equipment.
•	Training of the staff that will be in charge of the exploitation of the systems to ensure its autonomy
•	Users and administrators training.
•	Ensure the maintainability and the sustainability of the systems and projects 
•	Ensure knowledge transfer and reversibility to the CNES teams in order to ensure the ability to keep going with Project management, urbanization and mastering the new deployed tools 
These services therefore provide the entire life cycle of the projects that will arise from each of the topic.
All items will have to be compliant with CNES CSG's context and constraints
Although this publication is specific to a given topic, the tenderer must ensure the mutual consistency of the projects. He will have to coordinate with the teams in charge of planning and the overall architecture of the systems.
